storage_retention.title: Storage retention
storage_retention.description: Tool output (command results, file reads, search output) makes up most of the database. New messages are already trimmed as they are written, so this is a one-time cleanup of older history rather than an ongoing policy. Discarding aged tool output never touches your prompts, the agent's replies, or what the agent did; tool names, arguments, and file edits are preserved.

agent_diagram.title: Let the agent draw the diagram
agent_diagram.body: You use Excalidraw, but the agent has never drawn one for you. Ask it to sketch an architecture or flow and it will build the diagram directly through its tools.

animation_discover.title: Animate the part that only makes sense moving
animation_discover.body:
Create an **.anim.json** file to build an explainer that plays: a request crossing a cache, a queue draining, a retry after a timeout.

You write steps, not keyframes, so the agent can author and edit the whole thing as plain JSON.

canvas_discover.title: Lay your real files out on one board
canvas_discover.body:
A **.canvas** board holds cards that mount the actual editor for the file they point at -- the mockup renders, the spreadsheet shows real numbers, the document is editable in place.

Describe the board you want and the agent arranges it, wired with edges.
canvas_discover.action: Ask the agent for a board

files_agent_context.title: The agent understands your open file
files_agent_context.body: Open a file, then ask the agent to **explain, revise, or extend it**. The active file is included as context automatically.

files_visual_editors.title: Preview mockups and diagrams instantly
files_visual_editors.body: Files like **.mockup.html**, **.excalidraw**, and **.mindmap** open in visual editors. Ask the agent to create one and it renders live as it writes.

session_launch_shortcut.title: Start sessions without losing your place
session_launch_shortcut.body: Press **Cmd+Shift+N** anywhere in Nimbalyst to open the session launcher. Submit your prompt and the session starts in the background, so you stay right where you are.

action_prompts.title: Save reusable prompts as actions
action_prompts.body: Create **nimbalyst-local/ai-actions.md** to define one-click prompts. They show up in the composer's Actions dropdown -- great for recurring workflows like "review this diff" or "write release notes".

auto_commit.title: Auto-commit after every AI turn
auto_commit.body: Enable auto-commit in the Claude Code panel and every turn ends with a checkpoint commit. Easy to revert, hard to lose work to a runaway agent.

claude_md.title: Set standing instructions in CLAUDE.md
claude_md.body: Drop a **CLAUDE.md** at the workspace root with your coding conventions, preferred tools, and tone. Every session loads it automatically -- you only have to write it once.

content_search.title: Cmd+Shift+F searches inside files
content_search.body: Hit **Cmd+Shift+F** for cross-file regex search across the workspace. Results group by file with one-click jump-to-line.

datamodel_discover.title: Design schemas visually with DataModelLM
datamodel_discover.body: A **.datamodel** file is a Prisma-style schema with a live ER diagram. The agent can edit it like any source file, and you get the diagram for free.

doc_history.title: Cmd+Y to scrub document history
doc_history.body: Every save snapshots the file. **Cmd+Y** opens the history dialog with diffs against any earlier version -- click to restore. Hidden safety net for big edits.

document_shared.title: Share documents with one link
document_shared.body: Right-click a file and pick **Share** to publish an end-to-end-encrypted link. Recipients open it in a browser -- no Nimbalyst account needed.

excalidraw_discover.title: Sketch architecture in Excalidraw
excalidraw_discover.body: Create a **.excalidraw** file to draw boxes, arrows, and freeform diagrams. The agent can read and modify those drawings via tools -- great for system architecture and flow sketches.

keyboard_shortcuts.title: Learn the shortcuts that matter
keyboard_shortcuts.body: You have used the app for a while, but have not triggered any tracked keyboard shortcuts yet. The shortcuts dialog is a fast way to find the ones you will actually use.

lightning_interrupt.title: Lightning button stops a runaway
lightning_interrupt.body: If the agent is heading the wrong way, hit the **lightning bolt** next to the composer to interrupt it. Type a redirect into the composer and it resumes from there -- no need to wait the turn out.

mobile_keep_awake.title: Keep your computer awake for mobile prompts
mobile_keep_awake.body: Your computer going to sleep will disconnect mobile sync. Enable keep-awake while plugged in to prevent this.

mobile_paired.title: Drive sessions from your phone
mobile_paired.body: Pair the iOS app and prompt your Mac's agents from anywhere. The desktop runs the heavy work; you steer it from the couch or the road.

nimbalyst_coach.title: Find out what you are missing
nimbalyst_coach.body: Your agent can read this project and your recent sessions and tell you what would make them go better -- **extensions** that match your files, features you have not touched, and **instructions** worth adding so every future session starts smarter.

mockup_discover.title: Plan UI in a .mockup.html file
mockup_discover.body: Files ending in **.mockup.html** render as live, annotatable wireframes alongside source. Ask the agent to "create a mockup for X" to get a starting point you can edit visually.

quick_open.title: Cmd+O fuzzy-opens any file
quick_open.body: Skip the file tree. **Cmd+O** opens a fuzzy finder over every file in the workspace -- type a fragment of the path and hit enter.

session_cleanup.title: Let your agent tidy the Sessions board
session_cleanup.body: Your Sessions board is filling up. Your agent can **clean it up** -- fixing each session's phase, marking finished work **complete**, and flagging old sessions to archive.

session_shared.title: Share a session, not a screenshot
session_shared.body: Sessions can be published as **end-to-end-encrypted links** with 1, 7, or 30 day expiry. Use the share button on a session to send the full transcript to a teammate.

spreadsheet_discover.title: CSV files open as spreadsheets
spreadsheet_discover.body: Drop a **.csv** in the workspace and it opens with sorting, formulas, and AI tooling -- no need to flip to source view to make edits.

theme_explore.title: Try a different theme
theme_explore.body: You have been back a few times without changing the look of the app. **Themes** are already built in, and the settings panel shows the full set at once.

teams_multiplayer.title: Make this workspace multiplayer
teams_multiplayer.body: With **Teams**, your docs, mockups, diagrams, and trackers can be shared. Teammates edit the same files live or asynch, and each teammate's local agent works on those same shared artifacts. Promote any local file to shared in a click or create a new shared file. See how Teams works https://nimbalyst.com/teams

tracker_mode.title: Track work alongside your sessions
tracker_mode.body: You have been using AI sessions heavily, but **Tracker Mode** gives you a durable place to manage bugs, tasks, and decisions across those sessions.

wakeup.title: Let the agent page itself later
wakeup.body: Ask the agent to **schedule a wakeup** ("check the build in 5 minutes", "poll the PR every 30s") and it self-resumes -- no need to babysit a long-running task.

worktree_session.title: Isolate risky work in a worktree
worktree_session.body: You are deep into agent sessions on a git repo, but have not created a **worktree session** yet. Worktrees give experiments their own branch and working directory without disturbing the main checkout.

h2-security-encryption-section.title: Security & encryption
h2-security-encryption-section.body: Controls how your team's shared data is encrypted. End-to-end encrypted teams (desktop & mobile only) can be migrated to server-managed keys to unlock web, CLI, and AI-agent access — encrypted, isolated per team, and audit-logged, but no longer zero-knowledge. Your personal sync always stays end-to-end encrypted. Only owners and admins can migrate.

team-tab-inbox.title: Inbox
team-tab-inbox.body: Mentions, assignments, replies, and activity in conversations you follow across this organization. Tracker and document activity land here too, so the Inbox stays useful even when rooms are turned off.

org-rooms-section-add.title: Rooms
org-rooms-section-add.body:
Create a room or browse the directory.

Rooms are organization-wide conversations. **Public** rooms are open to everyone in the organization; **private** rooms are limited to the people you add. An organization can restrict room creation to admins in its settings — browsing stays open to everyone.

org-dms-section-add.title: Start a direct message
org-dms-section-add.body: A private conversation with up to seven other people. Direct messages cannot be renamed or joined later — pick the participants up front.

org-browse-rooms.title: Browse rooms
org-browse-rooms.body: Every room you can see: public rooms across the organization plus the private ones you belong to. Joining a public room makes its activity follow you into your Inbox.

org-rooms-create.title: Create a room
org-rooms-create.body: Add a new organization room. Public rooms are open to everyone; private rooms are limited to the members you add.

org-room-notifications.title: Notifications for this conversation
org-room-notifications.body:
Choose what reaches your Inbox from here:

- **All messages** — every message
- **Mentions only** — messages that @mention you
- **Nothing** — nothing at all

The setting is per conversation and follows you across devices.

org-room-actions.title: Room actions
org-room-actions.body: Invite members and open room settings — rename, edit the topic, manage membership and room admins, allow or block agent posting, or archive the room. Available to room admins and organization admins.

org-window-status-bar.title: Nimbalyst Teams is in beta
org-window-status-bar.body:
Expect bugs.

Organizations are free during beta and will require a paid Nimbalyst Teams subscription after launch; existing organizations get advance notice before any pricing change.

organization-settings-rooms-toggle.title: Rooms
organization-settings-rooms-toggle.body: Turn organization rooms off for an organization that chats elsewhere. The rooms section, the directory and room creation disappear for everyone; existing rooms are kept and come back if you turn this on again. The Inbox, document comments and tracker comments are unaffected.

organization-settings-dms-toggle.title: Direct messages
organization-settings-dms-toggle.body: Turn direct messages off for this organization. The direct-messages section and every compose path to a person disappear; existing conversations are kept and come back if you turn this on again.

organization-settings-room-creation.title: Who can create rooms
organization-settings-room-creation.body: Any member can create rooms by default. Restricting creation to organization admins leaves everyone else able to read, post in, and join the rooms that exist.

document-session-control.title: AI Sessions for This Document
document-session-control.body: Jump straight back into the last session on this document, or use the arrow to pick another session or start a new one.

org-mode-button.title: Organization
org-mode-button.body: Your organization's inbox, rooms and direct messages, for the organization this project belongs to.

file-tree-filter-button.title: Filter Your File Tree
file-tree-filter-button.body: Show only markdown files, uncommitted git changes, or files the AI has read or written in this session.

file-tree-quick-open-button.title: Quick Open Files
file-tree-quick-open-button.body: Search for any file in your project by name. Recently opened files appear at the top.

file-tree-new-file-button.title: New File
file-tree-new-file-button.body: Create a new file in the selected folder.

file-tree-new-folder-button.title: New Folder
file-tree-new-folder-button.body: Create a new folder in the selected folder.

file-tree-refresh-button.title: Refresh File Tree
file-tree-refresh-button.body: Reload the file list from disk to pick up files added or removed outside Nimbalyst.

ai-sessions-button.title: Past AI Sessions
ai-sessions-button.body: See AI sessions that edited this file. Jump back to continue a conversation or review changes.

file-history-button.title: Document History
file-history-button.body: View previous versions of this document. Restore or compare any saved state.

toc-toggle-button.title: Table of Contents
toc-toggle-button.body: Toggle the table of contents panel. Navigate quickly to any heading in the document.

diff-keep-button.title: Keep Changes
diff-keep-button.body: Accept the AI changes for this section and update the document.

diff-revert-button.title: Revert Changes
diff-revert-button.body: Reject the AI changes and restore the original content.

diff-keep-all-button.title: Keep All Changes
diff-keep-all-button.body: Accept all pending AI changes throughout the document.

diff-revert-all-button.title: Revert All Changes
diff-revert-all-button.body: Reject all pending AI changes and restore the original document.

nav-back-button.title: Navigate Back
nav-back-button.body: Go back to the previous file or location.

nav-forward-button.title: Navigate Forward
nav-forward-button.body: Go forward in your navigation history.

files-mode-button.title: Files Mode
files-mode-button.body: Browse and edit your project files with AI assistance on any document.

agent-mode-button.title: Agent Mode
agent-mode-button.body: Full AI coding agent with project-wide context, tool use, and multi-step tasks.

agent-sessions-bubble.title: Sessions Needing Attention
agent-sessions-bubble.body: Open sessions that are awaiting your input, currently running, or have unread output.

session-kanban-button.title: Kanban Board
session-kanban-button.body: Switch to a kanban board view of your sessions organized by phase: Backlog, Planning, Implementing, Validating, and Complete. Drag sessions between columns to update their status.

layout-controls.title: Session Layout Modes
layout-controls.body:
View your AI session and files edited together:

**Files**: Show only the file editor tabs. Available when you open an edited file in an AI Session.

**Split**: Show both transcript and editor stacked vertically. Drag the divider to adjust.

**Agent**: Show only the conversation transcript.

session-history-button.title: Session History
session-history-button.body: Browse past AI sessions. Search, filter, and resume previous conversations.

session-quick-open-button.title: Quick Open Session
session-quick-open-button.body: Search and jump to any AI session by content or title. Much faster than scrolling through history.

session-quick-search-button.title: Search Sessions
session-quick-search-button.body: Quickly find any AI session by name. Type **@** to search by file edited -- find every session that touched a specific file. Press **Tab** to switch to prompt search and find sessions by what you asked.

session-archive-button.title: Archive Session
session-archive-button.body: Archive this session to keep your session list organized. Archived sessions can be restored anytime.

tracker-automation-section.title: Tracker Automation
tracker-automation-section.body:
Automatically connect git commits to your tracker items. When enabled, Nimbalyst links commits via the session's tracker items and by parsing issue keys (e.g. **NIM-123**) from commit messages — including commits made in your terminal.

For project-specific behavior, add instructions to your project's **CLAUDE.md** (e.g. "always reference tracker issue keys in commits" or "don't auto-close critical bugs without review").

agent-input.title: AI Input
agent-input.body: Type your message or paste images and files. The AI has full context of your project.

plan-mode-toggle.title: Plan vs Agent Mode
plan-mode-toggle.body: Toggle between Plan and Agent modes. Plan mode creates structured plans before the AI writes code. Agent mode executes changes directly.

attach-files-input.title: Attach Files & Images
attach-files-input.body: Drag and drop files or paste images directly into the chat. You can also use @ to mention files from your project.

agent-welcome.title: Start Your First Session
agent-welcome.body: Create an AI coding session. Describe what you want to build, and the agent will help you.

files-scope-dropdown.title: File Scope Modes
files-scope-dropdown.body: Control which files are shown. View AI edits from this session, only uncommitted changes, or all files in the workspace. In workstreams, filter by individual session or see all sessions combined.

git-commit-mode-toggle.title: Commit Modes
git-commit-mode-toggle.body: Choose how to commit your changes. Manual lets you write your own message. Smart uses AI to analyze changes and propose a commit message.

git-operations-commit-with-ai-button.title: AI-Assisted Commit
git-operations-commit-with-ai-button.body: Have the AI analyze your changes and propose a set of files and a commit message for you to edit and approve.

model-picker.title: Select AI Model
model-picker.body: Choose which AI model to use. Different models have different capabilities and speeds.

model-picker-provider-claude-code.title: Claude Agent (Recommended)
model-picker-provider-claude-code.body: The in-app agent built on Claude Code with full Nimbalyst integration: it sees your active document and selection, renders the rich inline transcript, and tracks every file it edits. Runs on your Claude subscription when you sign in with your Claude plan, or on your Anthropic API key.

model-picker-provider-claude-code-cli.title: Claude Code CLI (Terminal Mode)
model-picker-provider-claude-code-cli.body: For people who prefer the command-line tool itself: runs the genuine claude binary in an embedded terminal, so you get its slash commands and TUI in the Raw terminal drawer while Nimbalyst mirrors the conversation into the rich transcript. You do not need this to use your Claude subscription.

action-prompts-dropdown.title: Action Prompts
action-prompts-dropdown.body: Reusable prompts you define in nimbalyst-local/ai-actions.md. Picking one inserts its body into the draft so you can tweak it before sending.

context-indicator.title: Context Window
context-indicator.body: Shows how much of the AI context window is used. Includes files, conversation history, and tools.

transcript-archive-button.title: Archive Session
transcript-archive-button.body: Archive this session to keep your session list tidy.

transcript-search-button.title: Search Transcript
transcript-search-button.body: Search within this conversation for specific messages or content.

voice-mode-toggle.title: Voice Mode
voice-mode-toggle.body: Speak to the AI instead of typing. The AI will respond with voice.

gutter-permissions-button.title: Agent Permissions
gutter-permissions-button.body: Configure which tools the AI agent can use. Control file access, command execution, and more.

gutter-sync-button.title: Session Sync
gutter-sync-button.body: Check sync status for this project and manage sync settings.

gutter-extension-dev-button.title: Extension Dev Mode
gutter-extension-dev-button.body: Open extension development tools, logs, and rebuild options.

gutter-theme-button.title: Theme
gutter-theme-button.body: Switch between light and dark themes.

gutter-feedback-button.title: Send Feedback
gutter-feedback-button.body: Share feedback or report issues with the team.

gutter-user-button.title: User Menu
gutter-user-button.body: Open user menu to access User Settings, Project Settings, Team Settings, and account info.

terminal-panel-button.title: Terminal
terminal-panel-button.body: Toggle the terminal panel for running commands.

tracker-mode-button.title: Trackers
tracker-mode-button.body: Switch to Tracker mode for a full project management view with table and kanban layouts.

collab-mode-button.title: Shared Documents
collab-mode-button.body: Browse and edit documents shared with your team in real-time. Collaborate on markdown, spreadsheets, and diagrams.

pr-review-mode-button.title: Pull Requests
pr-review-mode-button.body: Review GitHub pull requests without leaving the app: browse the list, read diffs and conversation, and approve or merge.

settings-project-tab.title: Project Settings
settings-project-tab.body: Settings specific to this project. Stored in the project folder.

settings-global-tab.title: Global Settings
settings-global-tab.body: Settings that apply to all projects.

settings-walkthroughs-toggle.title: Feature Guides
settings-walkthroughs-toggle.body: Show helpful guides for new features. Guides appear automatically as you use the app.

settings-walkthroughs-reset.title: Reset Guides
settings-walkthroughs-reset.body: Show all feature guides again, even ones you have already seen.

project-manager-open.title: Open Project
project-manager-open.body: Open a project folder from your computer.

project-manager-recent.title: Recent Projects
project-manager-recent.body: Your recently opened projects for quick access.

new-dropdown-button.title: Start a new session
new-dropdown-button.body: Create an AI coding session and describe what you want to build.

agent_mode.title: Agent Mode

files_mode.title: Files Mode
files_mode.body: Browse and edit your project files. Open markdown documents, code files, and more. The AI assistant sidebar is available here too.
